name: Strong open 09:50 (follow the first 20 minutes) — trending tape only (acr 1–5 min)
why: A large move in the first 20 minutes is institutional order flow (overnight orders, fund rebalancing executed at the open, stops above/below overnight levels) that keeps executing through the morning; late traders and trapped fades add to it. Tape filter pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_tape_filter_all.md).
